importance_ranking.reason: Significant visual variation across sub-types — polyfilm tunnel, polycarbonate panel structure, and shade net chamber look distinctly different. Buyers identify the structure type from the image before reading any text; wrong type is an immediate skip.

Covering material, frame type, and control system are non-interchangeable shortlisting criteria — a polycarbonate chamber cannot substitute for a polyfilm chamber in a budget-constrained government tender. Buyers arrive with site dimensions and propagation requirements and use specs to eliminate unsuitable suppliers.

importance_ranking.brand_important_reason: Market is fragmented across regional fabricators (TrueMIST, Waman Enterprises, Blue Stallion); no brand commands buyer recall or search-by-name behaviour in this category.
importance_ranking.reason: Custom fabrication with site installation means buyers evaluate the seller's installation track record, experience with government departments, and after-sales service capability — but specs carry equal weight in initial shortlisting.

Every mist chamber is custom-built to site dimensions; no fixed per-unit price exists. Listed price is a budget entry point only — final price is always quoted after site assessment and spec confirmation. India price sensitivity applies but comparison is not possible at listing stage.

importance_ranking.unit_note: Large custom installations are additionally quoted per sq mt of covered area, but since all pricing is project-based and finalised post-quotation, unit display at listing stage adds no buyer value. Per unit is the dominant catalogue reference.
importance_ranking.reason: Price is project-quoted and always negotiated post-site-assessment; unit ambiguity between per unit and per sq mt is resolved in the quotation process, not at listing stage.

top_configurator_specs.reason: Polycarbonate sheet vs UV polyfilm vs shade net are non-interchangeable across project requirements and represent the largest price delta in the category — polycarbonate structures cost substantially more than polyfilm equivalents of the same footprint.

Sensor-based automation vs manual control represents a significant price delta due to solenoid valves, humidity sensors, and controllers — and is non-interchangeable for research institute or government department requirements that specify automation tier.

missing_important_specs.why_important: Sellers cannot determine material quantities, structural design, or provide an accurate quotation without knowing the required footprint — size is the primary project scoping parameter for any custom-built structure.

High-pressure fogger systems vs low-pressure mister systems require different pumps, nozzles, and pipe specifications — a primary technical differentiator that drives system cost independently of covering material or control type.

top_rfq_specs.reason: Defines the structure type and light/humidity environment — sellers need this to determine material procurement, structural design, and pricing tier before they can respond meaningfully.

GI, MS, and aluminium frames have different corrosion resistance, load-bearing capacity, and cost points — sellers need this to confirm fabrication capability and quote the structural component accurately.

missing_important_specs.why_important: Sellers cannot determine material quantities, structural design, or provide any meaningful quotation without knowing the required footprint — this is the primary project scoping parameter.
